source.note: Circuit Boards Specifications, columns Standard and Advanced; tier standard is the first. Values in inches; outer layers listed by base copper.

copper_layer_counts.unpublished: The specifications page gives no layer counts.

min_track.quote: Outer Layer Line width on H ounce base copper | Minimum -0.004"
min_track.derived: 0.004 in = 4 mil; half-ounce base, about 1 oz finished

min_track.quote: Outer Layer Line width on 1 ounce base copper | Minimum -0.005"
min_track.derived: 0.005 in = 5 mil; 1 oz base, about 2 oz finished

min_gap.quote: Outer layer Feature to Feature on 1 ounce or less base copper | Minimum -0.005"

min_drill.unpublished: The specifications page gives pad and clearance sizes, no minimum drill.

min_annular_ring.quote: External Minimum Pad Size | 0.014" larger than finished hole size
min_annular_ring.derived: pad = finished hole + 0.014 in, so the ring is 0.007 in = 7 mil at the finished hole

min_hole_to_hole.unpublished: The specifications page gives no hole-to-hole spacing.

copper_to_edge.quote: Feature to Board Edge *does not include tabs | Minimum -0.010"

inner_pth_hole_to_copper.quote: PTH & NPTH Hole to Inner Layer Trace | 0.015" Spacing
